title: plugin-sharing, runtime: sharing_rule under regime C, so every same-name row is refused and declared rules are switched through the activation ledger (ruling A on #24378)
body:
Part of #24421'; check-partof-closing-keyword with this text as PR_BODY exits 0, and check-closing-keyword-parity exits 0.

Part of #24421
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

This PR carries items 2 and 5 of ruling A on #24378 (comment 6258883445, maintainer 「24378 同意 A」), which supersedes ruling B′. ADR-0131 D6 now charts `sharing_rule` under regime C: a declared sharing rule is read-only and clonable, and it is switched through the activation ledger. The scope is the claim amendment 6258985416. The ownership-ceremony step (each customised copy becomes a clone plus the base switched off) is a later stage, which carries the card's closing line.

## What changed

**The guard: every same-name row is refused with 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, naming the declared rule.** It applies at both write doors.
- `SharingRuleService.defineRule` covers `POST /api/v1/sharing/rules`, the SDK's `shares.rules.save` and any service caller. A rule created under a declared name is refused whether or not that rule is switched off. The first round's `id`-addressed projection edit is removed, so there is no customised-copy door. A stored row that already holds a declared name stays editable as itself: that is the upsert path, not a new row.
- `bindDeclaredRuleNameGuard`, a `beforeInsert` / `beforeUpdate` hook on `sys_sharing_rule`, covers the `/data` door. It refuses an insert of a declared name, and an update that renames a row onto one (judged against `ctx.previous`). System writes pass.
- `DeclaredSharingRuleNameConflictError` carries `code` `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` and `status` 409, which is `HttpStatusErrorCodeMap[409]`. It is catalogued, so nothing is minted. Its message tells the caller to create their rule under another name and to switch the declared rule off through the activation door.

**The ledger switch.** `sys_metadata_activation` now records `metadata_type` `sharing_rule` (`SHARING_RULE_ACTIVATION_TYPE`).
- `declaredRules` reads the ledger once per call, as `readPositionActive` does: no ledger object means no read, and a failed read switches nothing off. A declared rule switched off is served in no scope.
- `bindSharingRuleActivationReconcile` hooks `afterInsert` / `afterUpdate` / `afterDelete` on the ledger and calls `reconcileDeclaredRuleActivation(name)` in the same request. Switched off, the rule's name-keyed grants are purged across every scope. Switched on, each projection's one-rule pass re-derives them. When scopes are unknown, nothing is reconciled. A failure is thrown to the door, which answers 5xx. The ledger row is not rolled back: a code-registered hook opens no abort unit, so the grants converge at the next boot sweep or the next flip (contract review 2, ③).
- The door is the existing catalog activation door, `POST /api/v1/security/_activation/:type/:name` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts`), with `sharing_rule` admitted. It enforces the same two tiers: `manage_metadata`, then the ADR-0126 §5 posture rule, which makes the switch the platform operator's under a wall. The name is resolved through the `sharingRules` service (`declaredRuleNamed`), and the row records the registry item's `_packageId` (new `DeclaredSharingRule.packageId`). An undeclared name answers 404. With no service bound, or a failed read, the door answers 503.

**A declaration over a stored row.** When a package declares a rule whose name a stored row already holds (a package upgrade, or a pre-C customised copy), the row is never treated as an overlay. It answers as its own rule. The declaration is withheld in that scope, and the conflict is logged at `error` once per name and scope per process, with the remedy (rename the row, and switch the declared rule off if it must not grant).

**Dropped:** the first round's immediate reconcile on `sys_sharing_rule` writes, and its delete path. `sharing-plugin.ts`'s rule trigger is back to `main`'s shape, and the `id` pluck in `sharing-routes.ts` is reverted.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test`: 48 files / 1156 tests. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/runtime`: the 7 activation-door test files, 145 tests. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/rest`: the sharing-rule test files, 19 tests. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `sharing-rule.test.ts`, block "regime C", 17 pins:
  - A rule taking the declared name is refused 409 for an org admin and for a system context, with nothing landing. A projection id is refused. A switched-off rule still holds its name.
  - Clone plus base-off revokes the base's grants everywhere in the same write, keeps the clone's grants, and leaves nothing for the boot sweep. Switching it back on re-derives the grants.
  - Another type's ledger row does nothing. A failed ledger read revokes nothing. A switched-off rule cannot be deleted (403).
  - A declaration over a stored row is withheld and reported once, and the row stays editable. Walled, it is reported per organization.
  - The `/data` door refuses an insert and a rename onto the name.
  - Walled, one ledger row switches the rule off in every organization and back on. Unknown scopes reconcile nothing.
- `catalog-activation-door.test.ts`, 6 pins for `sharing_rule`: switched under `single` with the package recorded; operator-only under `group` / `isolated`; 404 for an undeclared name; 503 with no service; 503 on a failed read; a row with no package.
- `sharing-rule-declared-name-conflict.test.ts`: `POST /sharing/rules` answers 409 nested.
- Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; each leg restored, `blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty; the tests import `src/` relatively):

  | Ablated | Red |
  |---|---|
  | `defineRule` throw | 5 |
  | the ledger filter in `declaredRules` | 3 |
  | the ledger hook's reconcile call | 3 |
  | the declaration-over-row report | 2 |
  | the `/data` hook throw | 2 |
  | the door's `declaredRuleNamed` lookup | 3 |

Gates were run locally at `768fc0b2c`: 149 commands, made up of the 101 families `dispatch-gates --commands` derived plus the artifact-roster block. 145 exited 0. `--ran` reports 101 derived, 101 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The other four need PR or event context: `check-closing-target-claim`, `check-single-claim-paths`, `check-partof-closing-keyword` (exit 0 with `PR_BODY` set) and `check-governed-queue-guard`.

## Acceptance notes

- The ADR-0087 marker stays `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, as the contract review on the first round decided from ADR-0087 D8 and ADR-0131 D13. `check:adr-0087-registration` accepts it.
- Files outside the plugin, all within the amended surface or doc-comment only:
  - `runtime/src/domains/{catalog-activation,activation-gate}.ts`: the activation door.
  - `runtime/src/domains/security.ts`, `dispatcher-plugin.ts`, `route-ledger.ts`: notes now name `sharing_rule`.
  - `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 40: the guard's `isSystem` anchor.
- `sys-metadata-activation.object.ts` is unchanged. Its `metadata_type` description reads "('flow', 'permission', …)" and needed no edit.
- Not in this PR:
  - the ceremony step, the stage that finishes the card;
  - objectui#12982 (Disable and Clone);
  - `content/docs/permissions/sharing-rules.mdx`, which does not describe regime C yet.
